title: two files of one layer with the same id are one build: the first file by name wins and the second is not listed
source: intended: builds come from layers (repo, trusted parent folders, user folder), nearest wins (docs/decisions.md)
intent: INTENDED behavior (defect N-12, build layers). Shadowing is by id, also inside one layer: when two files of the project's jitso/builds/ carry the same id, the first by file name is the build of that id and the second is never listed or launched.
